title: Better language models and their implications
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/better-language-models).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
